description: Stereo emulation of the ProCo Rat stomp box, ported from Valdemar Erlingsson's VST, with four of its known modifications switchable and a CV input for every control

params.text: Takes the distortion out of the signal path, so the input passes straight to the output
Sets the tone filter of the distortion
Sets how hard the distortion is driven
Sets the level of the signal leaving the module
How much of the voltage at the FILTER CV input reaches the FILTER setting
How much of the voltage at the GAIN CV input reaches the GAIN setting
How much of the voltage at the VOLUME CV input reaches the VOLUME setting
Switches the Turbo modification of the circuit in and out
Switches the overdrive modification of the circuit in and out
Switches the Ruetz modification of the circuit in and out
Switches the Tight modification of the circuit in and out

inputs.text: The left side of the stereo input
The right side of the stereo input
A trigger switches the bypass on and off
A voltage moving the FILTER setting
A voltage moving the GAIN setting
A voltage moving the VOLUME setting
A trigger switches the Turbo modification in and out
A trigger switches the overdrive modification in and out
A trigger switches the Ruetz modification in and out
A trigger switches the Tight modification in and out

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo output
The right side of the stereo output
